title: Event Details

fields.label: Date
fields.name: kwv_event_date
fields.instructions: The date the event takes place. After this date the event automatically moves to Draft and drops out of the booking dropdowns. It stays live on the day itself.

description: Custom fields for the Events (kwv_event) post type. The Brand (venue) link is a taxonomy, and the featured image is the native WordPress Featured Image. Managed as code in the KWV Enhancements plugin's /acf-json directory.
